decisions.reason: It fits closely with the firm's established compact construction equipment range and should benefit from its engineering, service and spare-parts strengths in a growing market.
As an adjacent extension of the firm's existing dumper and construction offer, it is worth retaining to build scale and customer coverage after only a short time on the market.

The underground mine rescue vehicle is relatively far from the firm's core offer and likely serves a narrower, more specialized market that demands focus and resources better used in the core portfolio and nearer-term developments.

The compact telescopic loader is a natural complement to the firm's established construction and lifting equipment business and aligns well with its customer-specific adaptation and service capabilities.
